scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run build:npm
scripts.check: bun run test:sandbox -- bun run check:repo
scripts.check:repo: bun run build && bun run test && bun run ultracite:doctor && bun run skillset:check && bun run docs:check && bun run check:pack && git diff --check && bun run package-ownership:guard && bun run terminology:guard && bun run cli-surface:guard && bun run target-topology:guard
scripts.check:pack: bun run build:npm && bun scripts/package-metadata.ts check && bun scripts/package-smoke.ts
scripts.check:workflows: if command -v actionlint >/dev/null 2>&1; then actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml; else echo 'skillset: actionlint not installed; skipping workflow lint'; fi
scripts.conformance:adapters: bun run test:sandbox -- bun run conformance:adapters:repo
scripts.conformance:determinism: bun run test:sandbox -- bun run conformance:determinism:repo
scripts.conformance:external: bun run test:sandbox -- bun run conformance:external:repo
scripts.conformance:external:sync: bun run test:sandbox -- bun run conformance:external:sync:repo
scripts.conformance:fast: bun run test:sandbox -- bun run conformance:fast:repo
scripts.conformance:fast:repo: bun run conformance:determinism && bun run conformance:adapters
scripts.docs:check: bun run test:sandbox -- bun scripts/docs.ts check
scripts.hooks:pre-commit: bun run test:sandbox -- lefthook run pre-commit --force
scripts.hooks:pre-push: bun run test:sandbox -- lefthook run pre-push --force
scripts.publish:check: bun run test:sandbox -- bun run publish:check:repo
scripts.publish:check:repo: bun run check && bun scripts/publish.ts check
scripts.skillset:check:outputs: bun run test:sandbox -- bun ./apps/skillset/src/cli.ts check --only outputs --root .
scripts.test: bun run test:sandbox -- bun test --timeout 15000 $(git ls-files 'apps/**/*.test.ts' 'packages/**/*.test.ts' 'scripts/**/*.test.ts')
scripts.test:distribution: bun run test:sandbox -- bun test --timeout 60000 apps/skillset/src/__tests__/launcher.test.ts scripts/__tests__/distribution-conformance.test.ts scripts/__tests__/distribution-workflow-contract.test.ts scripts/__tests__/native-artifacts.test.ts scripts/__tests__/native-packages.test.ts scripts/__tests__/release-packages.test.ts
